summary: Per-driver session-phase completion tracker in the AI/session event pipeline. When the race is active (dword_7D0308 nonzero, flt_7CF3C8 nonzero, dword_7C56A8 not 8), it sets the completion flag for the given phase index (this+0xA44 + 4*phase) and counts how many of the four phase flags are set. If fewer than three are set it emits an individual phase event (ID 95/97/99/101 depending on the phase index, dispatched through jump table jpt_41AA9C); otherwise it emits the combined event (ID 105). In both cases the event is materialized into a local descriptor by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and appended to the session event table via InsertDriverTableEntry. Called per-frame from VehicleDynamicsForceAccumulatorIntegration (00438130).

local_names.this: per-driver session state carrying four phase-completion flags
local_names.a2: phase index 0-3 selecting which completion flag to set and which event to emit
local_names.v6: local 8-DWORD event descriptor filled by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion
local_names.v3: running count of set phase-completion flags

operations.description: Whole body gated on the session being live: dword_7D0308 (race active) nonzero, flt_7CF3C8 (track condition) not equal to 0.0, and dword_7C56A8 (race phase) not equal to 8
Sets the completion flag for the phase: writes 1 to this[a2 + 657], i.e. the DWORD at this+0xA44 + 4*a2
StructInitWithSentinelValues initializes the local 8-DWORD event descriptor v6 with sentinel defaults before the table lookup fills it
Iterates the four phase-completion flags at this+0xA44 .. this+0xA44+0xC (4 DWORDs), incrementing the count v3 for each nonzero entry

Branches on the count: when fewer than 3 flags are set, switches on the phase index a2 through the jump table jpt_41AA9C to select the individual phase event; otherwise selects the combined event (105)
DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion fills v6 for the chosen event ID (95/97/99/101 per phase index 0-3, or 105 for the combined case) with default index -1 arguments and -2.0 sentinel times
InsertDriverTableEntry appends the filled descriptor v6 to the session event table pointed at by flt_5EA618

unresolved: flt_59E440 is listed by the packet globals but never appears in the raw decompiled source; the skeleton fill calls it a zero-threshold constant, which is unverifiable from this packet
The packet records field this+0xA44 as read-only even though the raw source writes it; the effective write target is this+0xA44 + 4*a2
The -2.0 sentinel values and the -1 default indices passed to DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion have unknown meaning
